outline:
Discuss the digital modulation techniques and system design.
1. Introduction to digital communications
2. Fundamental Passband digital modulation techniques (PSK, QAM, FSK, MSK) with noise
3. Band-pass signal and systems
4. Error Control Coding
5. Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM)
-
schedule:
1st week Introduction to digital communication systems
2nd-5rd weeks PSK with noise
6th-8th weeks QAM with noise
9th week Midterm exam
10th-11th weeks FSK with noise
11th-13th weeks Band-pass signals and systems
14th-17th weeks Orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM)
18th week Final exam
